head.text: WF-036 Bit rate switch at the BRS bit and switch back at the CRC delimiter

foot.text: Nominal bit 10 quanta, data bit 4 quanta. The controller switches immediately after the sample point of the recessive BRS bit: that bit lasts 1 + 6 nominal quanta plus PHASE_SEG2 of the data configuration (8 quanta); the CRC delimiter lasts SYNC + SEG1 in data quanta plus PHASE_SEG2 in nominal quanta (6 quanta). Together they last one nominal plus one data bit (REF-002 section 8).
